roleTitle: Field Service Operations Manager, Elevator Maintenance Scheduling
jobDescription: Technicians across the northern region are dispatched to elevator maintenance and repair jobs by the scheduling system, and the branches depend on it every working hour. This manager is the person who keeps that dispatching running: primary holder of the dispatch desk's production support rota, first responder when dispatching stops, the coordinator of vendor changes into the live system, the keeper of the response-time figures used in service contract reviews, and the author of the notes that record what the service can and cannot do after each incident. Reports to the regional service director; works daily with the dispatch desk, eleven branches and the vendor's support team.
requirements: Keeps the dispatch system dispatching in live operation and is the first responder when a production incident stops dispatching.
Is the primary holder of the dispatch desk's production support rota and the branch escalation route.
Brings vendor changes into the live system through the quarterly change window and records where own checks end and the vendor's begin.
Keeps the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for service contract reviews current.
Records known limitations and hand-over conditions in the post-incident and change notes.

evidence.text: Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.

First responder to every production incident that stopped dispatching in those four years; the three vendor outages of 2023 and 2024 are logged under my name in the regional incident log with the vendor's ticket numbers.
Brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window, with the change log recording my acceptance checks separately from the vendor's regression checks.
Kept the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for the eleven branches current for the service contract reviews, revising the runbook after each incident and each release.
Wrote the post-incident notes and the release hand-over notes, recording the known limitations of the technician availability feed and what the next rota holder needed to know.
Work sample: regional incident log extracts for the three vendor outages with the vendor ticket numbers, the change log for the last four quarterly windows and the current dispatch runbook.

Recruiter screen: asked what 'running the dispatch system' meant in practice, the candidate described holding the rota, taking the three vendor outage calls and running the change windows; the dates he gave agree with the resume and the incident log extracts.

Hiring manager pre-read: the regional service director asks that the packet cite the incident log extracts by ticket number and show the rota period, and that any vendor test-environment activity be listed separately from live operation.

propositions.text: The candidate was the primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through him.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the rota period.

propositions.text: The candidate was first responder to the production incidents that stopped dispatching, including three vendor outages logged under his name, and brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the incident log extracts document the incidents and the change windows.

propositions.text: The candidate kept the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures current for the service contract reviews and wrote the post-incident and release hand-over notes with the known limitations.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the runbook, the figures and the notes.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the live operation, the rota, the incidents and the documentation.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The live operation, rota and incident handling are documented in the resume and the incident log extracts; keep the environment as stated.
followUpTargets: Ask for the vendor ticket numbers of the three outages to be checked against the vendor's portal.
